Fingerprint scanners 👆 are biometric systems that identify you using unique patterns on your fingers.
.
Every fingerprint has ridges, valleys, and minutiae points that are nearly impossible to replicate.
.
1️⃣ Capture — sensor takes an image or reads the fingerprint pattern
2️⃣ Types — optical (light), capacitive (electric charge), ultrasonic (sound waves)
3️⃣ Feature Extraction — key points like ridge endings & bifurcations are detected
4️⃣ Template Creation — fingerprint data is converted into a digital map
5️⃣ Matching — scanned print is compared with stored template for verification
.
It doesn’t store your actual fingerprint image — only a mathematical representation.
That’s why it’s fast, secure, and widely used in phones and security systems.
.
.
.
